findings.description: The policy grants unrestricted ec2:*, s3:*, lambda:*, and cloudwatch:* actions against every resource. Attached to the svc_deploy IAM user, this violates least privilege and permits broad modification and data access across those services, including potentially destructive and privilege-enabling actions.

The output exposes the IAM access key encrypted secret without marking it sensitive. Terraform will store this output in state and may display it in CLI output or downstream automation, increasing the risk of credential disclosure to anyone able to read those locations.
